name: Bursa Malaysia Berhad
summary: Bursa Malaysia Berhad, an exchange holding company, provides treasury management, and management and administrative services in Malaysia and internationally. The company operates through six segments: Securities Market, Derivatives Market, Islamic Market, Data Business, Exchange Holding Business, and Others. It engages in provision and operation of the listing, trading, clearing, and depository services on the securities exchange and trading and clearing services on the derivatives exchange.
